name: Cathayopterus
sum: Ctenochasmatid from the Early Cretaceous Yixian Formation of Liaoning, China.
material: Single incomplete skull in dorsal view, left side damaged.
biology: Teeth splaying outwards at the snout tip, like Ctenochasma; probably a filter feeder.
author: Wang and Zhou 2006

species.name: Cathayopterus grabaui
species.author: Wang and Zhou 2006
